steps.name: Franka
steps.text: An apple party...?

steps.name: Myrtle
steps.text: Exactly! I looked it up with Utage and Click. There's a wild apple forest not too far away from here right in season. There's so many apples there, we'd have enough to keep the party going for three whole days!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: And it'll cost us nothing!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: That sounds great. Be sure to invite me.

steps.name: Myrtle
steps.text: Oh! W-Wait up!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Well, we're 100% certain we'll, ahem, just happen to walk by that apple forest on our next mission. There's one little problem though... The mission's captain...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: It's *her*.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Oh, I see. If she's in charge, then I guess she's going to do everything by the book.

steps.name: Myrtle
steps.text: That's why we came to you for help. We're not sure how to break the ice with her...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: How about you give her some of those apples? But, well, it's true she's not the type of leader to just let her team members wander off.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Rhodes Island is heading through a pretty safe area right now, but there are still many hidden dangers out there.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: So... What do you think of our plan?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: It sounds a little difficult to pull off, but... I think it's good! And if the apple party gives you a chance to hit it off with her, that's two beasts with one stroke.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Let me give you a few suggestions. Hmm... For example...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Here's a hot tip I'll let you in on. She actually really likes it when people kick up a fuss about her.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Hm? That sounds so sketchy...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: It's 100% real, you have my word. Secondly, do not finish reading her mission handbook.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: That's also kinda...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: And thirdly—

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Uh, what was the third one... Oh, right.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: As long you don't hear any sparky sounds around her, just pick on her as much as you want!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Um, hold on, that's probably a little too gutsy, even for us...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Jeez, why would I lie to you? And here I was trying to help you guys out.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Haha... I trust you. I just don't know if we're ballsy enough to buy into that whole idea.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hehe, no worries. If she starts getting really mad and that scares you, you can tell her I told you guys to do that.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: She took all of my field ops even though I only got a few scratches... I'm counting on you to really teach her a lesson... I mean... to get along with her.

steps.name: Myrtle
steps.text: I see! I get it now!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Ugh, I don't get it at all—

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Let's stop here for our orientation.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Myrtle
steps.text: (Click, Utage, you two ready? The mission's a go!)

steps.name: Click
steps.text: (Okay.)

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: To ensure our mission comes to a successful conclusion, I've already looked into the abilities, specialties, personalities, and combat styles of everyone on our patrol unit today and made the necessary arrangements...

steps.name: Myrtle
steps.text: Whoa—Check this out, Click! It's an apple tree!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Myrtle is excellent at boosting her teammates' morale and can also help provide medical assistance. When we perform reconnaissance in pairs, she also analyzes the situation well and provides good, reliable suggestions.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: A-Ahem.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Let me take a look with my camera—

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Whoa, you're right! Nice! Who knew we would be so lucky today~!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: On the other hand, Click is very dependable in both support and record-keeping capacities. These are especially useful in patrol and recon missions.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: I betcha these apple trees have been around for centuries. If we pick all the apples here, we can make so many tasty apple desserts, it'll last us three whole days!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: We don't get this kinda chance every day!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Utage is very agile. That makes her well-suited for recon in the frontlines.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: And Vanilla is dependably strong in actual combat...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Thanks, Captain!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: And actually, I... I'm pretty fond of apple desserts too.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: All of you... Listen. To. Me.

steps.name: Everyone
steps.text: S-Sorry!

steps.name: Myrtle
steps.text: You girls should be ashamed of yourselves! How could you talk while the squad captain's speaking?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Myrtle, how could you...!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: That's what you say, Myrtle, but I can so see it in your eyes. You're totes thinking about those haystacks all the way over there, the comfy sunshine, and the apple forest.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Yeah, what she said! If anyone's mind's not here, it's gotta be Myrtle!

steps.name: Myrtle
steps.text: W-What? Now that's not nice, slandering your friend with wild guesses!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Hmph, I thought we could get through this mission without sticking to the rules so much... but your laziness is far beyond my expectations.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: She's right. If you girls worked at Blacksteel and the higher-ups found you slacking off like this, you wouldn't get away with just a bad performance evaluation.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Tsk, just hearing the word 'performance' is enough to kill my mood three times over...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: You'll miss out on so many opportunities to just chill if you always try to be such a good girl, Vanilla. Gotta learn how to slack off whenever it's okay to.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Oh, yeah, why don't you join our 'Apple Patrol' group?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Huh? But the Blacksteel handbook doesn't let us...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Think about it. Our job today is to patrol the area. You can just call it a kinda unexpected outcome of our little trip.

steps.name: Myrtle
steps.text: Yep, yep. I mean, that's a whole field of yummy apples waiting for us, all gratis!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Patrol and recon missions are not to be abused like that.

steps.name: Click&Myrtle
steps.text: Mmm...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Oh, come on, Captain Liskarm! Aside from Vanilla, none of us here have gone through any actual PMC training!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: We just fight the way it feels right, that's all!

steps.name: Myrtle
steps.text: T-That's right...!

steps.name: Myrtle
steps.text: I'm just here to get some simple missions under my belt...

steps.name: Myrtle
steps.text: And if I get to brag all about it to my parents and my brothers when Rhodes Island is stopped close to my hometown, that's good enough for me.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I thought I made it clear to you yesterday that you must review the mission handbook in its entirety. Now, I can still make this pleasant.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: So long as one of you answers what the operational time and commands listed in the handbook are correctly.

steps.name: Myrtle
steps.text: Ugh, but that mission plan was way too long!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: And like I said, this actually...

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Of course we know we gotta stay alert and what we gotta look out for while we're out on patrol missions.

steps.name: Click
steps.text: But I really agree with Myrtle here, Captain Liskarm. Your mission plan is just way... way too detailed!

steps.name: Myrtle
steps.text: That's right. How do you expect us to keep up when you have our positions and actions during the patrol laid out down to the second?!

steps.name: Myrtle
steps.text: We're humans, not machines that run on Originium!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Even those robots we have back at Rhodes Island have more personality than what you're asking for.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I did all this for your own good—

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: We could find ourselves in all kinds of unexpected situations even on the simplest patrol missions. We could run into violent mutant Originium Slugs, the weather could suddenly take a turn for the worse, and we could even run into bandits.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Of course, I still have a backup plan. That said... hmph.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: All of you are severely lacking in actual combat experience. That worries me—

steps.name: Click
steps.text: So... Captain Liskarm, you're trying to make things easier for us this way?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I... I get it now! This is just the best way Captain Liskarm could come up with to make the information digestible, by turning it into study materials!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: I knew I'd come across someone this serious one of these days, but well...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: For lack of a better term, you're like an honor student with these habits of yours.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: What do you mean, 'honor student?'
With these habits, you are really quite the honor student.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Tsk...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: So, Liskarm, how come you're always such an honor student, so obsessed with carrying out your combat plans by the book?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I think you'd be more interesting. Like, that ability of yours where you just shoot out electricity with a spark is so much cooler than anything I've ever seen.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: What makes you say that?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: It's just the vibe I'm getting from you, I guess.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: We've teamed up for three days now. I don't know how you feel about them, but I've had a lot of fun. There's so many great things about you that have piqued my interest.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: But it wasn't until we came to the field together today that I noticed this. You and I don't actually get along that well.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: What a coincidence. I feel the same way.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Franka, if I'm not mistaken, our superior, Dr. Janet Longfellow, should already have taught you to be rigorous and meticulous, and to always maintain a basic level of safety awareness as a Blacksteel employee.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Yeah, I'm sick of hearing all that.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: That's what you stubborn types always say: gotta stick to the rules and all that, but you guys never try to stand in my shoes either.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I passed all of Blacksteel's operator evaluations fair and square, and I got As in almost all the categories, so that makes me half an honor student too, doesn't it?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I've more than proven myself, but why are the higher-ups are so antsy about keeping me in check? They even went through all that HR nightmare just to have the two of us buddy up.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You should've filed your grievances before the mission if you were going to complain.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I have no doubt you are more than capable. It's part of the basics to get a good grasp of your partner's abilities, after all.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Which is why I would appreciate it if you would understand that, based on the results of our evaluations alone, there is a 1% difference between you and me.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: See? You got a 1% difference because of how uptight you are.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I mean, how uptight do you have to be to lay out your plans on the battlefield down to the second?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Let's just say I wanted to do the pointless work, then.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: However, know that I drew these conclusions by analyzing and simulating all the courses of action we could take, and I've also taken into account all unexpected situations we could find ourselves in.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Do you think my cautiousness is a bad thing?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I'm not saying it's a bad thing.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: It's a pain in the ass, though.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Both of us can access each other's files, Liskarm.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: And I know how you got your teammates hurt because there were problems with your command.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Are you sure those teammates didn't make those mistakes because they relied on that cautiousness of yours a little too much?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Likewise, your obsession with acting on your own and your lack of concern for your teammates' safety when you strayed into enemy territory were also recorded in the files.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Surely you haven't forgotten about that?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hah.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I hate to admit it, but we're both alive and kicking and right in front of each other. Don't you think it's funny that we're basing our image of each other on some silly rumors and data?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: That's why I would prefer it if you could at least try to understand the concerns of your fellow teammates.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You need to understand just how haphazard it is to take on all the dangers yourself. I am sure you've already learned about this the hard way multiple times.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Are you worried about me?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Right... I suppose I am.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: For the time being, we are partners.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Partners, huh...?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I think the longest that a duo has stuck together with each other at Blacksteel was only, what, four years?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: They change our posts often to make sure we get used to a wider variety of environments and circumstances.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Though Janet has also said that both you and I are too quirky, so it's hard for us to find suitable partners.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: And to prove that we'd work well together as a team, she said she'd give us enough time to get used to working with each other.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Considering how we've already wasted much of our time on this needless debate, I can already imagine how long it'll take before we tolerate each other.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: *Sigh*... It's only my first mission, but my evaluation will likely take a huge hit.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: My performance evaluation—

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hehe... This isn't that bad either, is it?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I mean, the way you do all your homework beforehand is kinda extreme, but it's not a bad thing to take precautions.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: If you can manage to predict even some of my so-called out-of-line actions, that might actually be a huge improvement to both of us.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: We'll see if you're worth the extra effort, then.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Likewise, Franka, it's true that I wasn't able to prevent my teammates from getting injured with my calculations.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I admit I still have a long way to go.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Keeping your sense of responsibility in check is a means to keep a cooler head.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Oh, don't worry. If we really do hit it off with each other, I could help poke holes in those mission plans of yours in actual combat.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Feel free to keep bluffing.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Do show me how you would relieve yourself of your sense of responsibility and keep your cool during combat.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Heh, well don't you blink for even a moment then.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: *Cough*... *cough*. Are you okay, Liskarm?!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I-I'm okay...

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Well, I didn't expect you to actually have a few more tricks up your sleeve.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: What's this now? Some kind of last-gasp attack bordering on cutting your tail off?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: This is nothing as scary as that... *Sigh*...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: This is just... a last-ditch effort... to clean up your mess.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: I'm pretty sure I am the one cleaning somebody's mess here.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: And here I thought you had the battlefield so under control, you had everything figured out down to the second, but looks like you're just another dummy who can't keep herself from electrocuting everything when things get hairy.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You could at least stop mocking me when I'm so exhausted.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Either bring me back so I can get some rest there, or just leave me alone and give me some peace and quiet...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: What's the matter, Franka...?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Hey, Franka? Are you taking me with you or not?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You're leaving me behind in a battlefield?!

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hm, I thought you couldn't move even a bit?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Of course I can. Do you really think that much could wear me out?

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Hmph... Well, in that case, I guess I can torment you however I want?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Wait, what are you doing...? Don't touch my hair!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I'm definitely going to talk to Dr. Longfellow tomorrow. I'll tell her all about this and have her call off this dreaded team-up—

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Yeah, I'd like to see you try.

steps.name: Franka
steps.text: Need I remind you just how much Janet loves me?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: (*Sigh*, why do I remember all this down to the details?)

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Liskarm, are you mad?

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I'm sorry. I'll try to get them to calm down too.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Don't worry. I get it too. This is just a normal patrol and recon mission.

steps.name: Myrtle
steps.text: W-We aren't trying to give you a hard time, Captain Liskarm. Sorry...

steps.name: Click
steps.text: I mean, all of us really respect how Blacksteel does things. How strict they are, how they emphasize safety and whatnot, but that's just out of our reach...

steps.name: Myrtle
steps.text: I've actually finished reading that guidebook, you know! I mean, you gave it to us. How could I not? You mentioned all of my weaknesses in the book, and I really tried to memorize it all! It's just... getting everything memorized isn't my forte...

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Yeah, I thought this would happen.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: As I've been trying to say, I'm not really as inflexible as you're making me out to be. Things aren't set in stone just because I'm in charge of this mission.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Here is the actual pre-operation handbook. It'll only take you a minute to remember everything.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I also considered the likelihood of us coming across apple trees and the fact that apples are currently in season, and set aside twenty minutes for us to pick apples.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I have a few gathering tools tucked away in my bag as well...

steps.name: Click
steps.text: N-Nice!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: That being the case, we still have to bring our mission to a successful conclusion. Is that understood?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Hehe, just what I wanted to hear! Wait till we're done making our desserts! We'll give you the biggest portion!

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I didn't mention anything about my penchant for desserts... Ahem, anyway, listen up for the next minute!

steps.name: Everyone
steps.text: Roger that!

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: (Liskarm has actually given some thought to the things that everyone else on the team has in mind.)

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: (Here I was thinking I had to work with her and play the role of a steadfast Blacksteel mercenary. Was I overthinking it?)

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: (Franka even told me, 'When Liskarm's leading a team by herself, things are bound to run off the rails if there's even a single mischievous person on the team. You gotta stand on her side...')

steps.name: Click
steps.text: (Whispers) Vanilla, is Captain Liskarm actually the type who likes a wily team?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: I thought she'd be so mad after we made that ruckus, but it looks like... she's not that mad... and she's not letting off sparks or anything?

steps.name: Myrtle
steps.text: We heard Liskarm's just as unreasonable and cold as the rumors make her out to be, that she's a true professional who has absolutely no personal feelings.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Well, I can vouch for her professionalism.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: And she also doesn't get mad even if you pretend to be difficult, although that doesn't mean she likes it either.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Liskarm is a professional who can tolerate even Franka's nonsensical personality.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: I don't really think any of you are unreasonable. I'm sure she feels the same way too.

steps.name: Vanilla
steps.text: Did you guys... get pranked by someone maybe?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Ahaha... Well...

steps.name: Myrtle
steps.text: H-Hahaha, there's no way I would ever be bamboozled like that!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Wait, hold on. Now that you mention it, is it possible that she saw our whole putting on an act plan coming?

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Wait a minute. Perhaps she did it on purpose, trying to get us to make a fool of ourselves.

steps.name: Myrtle
steps.text: I-It's not out of the question that they set us up together—

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: You could've at least waited till you were out of my earshot.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: I can hear everything.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Sorry, Captain Liskarm—

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: (Whatever. This is probably all Franka's doing.)

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: (I guess... it's getting more and more difficult for me to act as strict as I used to back at Blacksteel.)

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: (It's just not easy to keep up that unsympathetic facade anymore now that I'm at Rhodes Island.)

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: (Sigh... if Franka finds out, she's definitely going to make fun of me for even trying to bluff.)

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: (If I wasn't with Rhodes Island now, I'm sure I'd have driven myself completely over the edge with how inflexible I used to be.)

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: (I've changed so much, and I didn't even notice until much later.)

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: (It was never a problem of good or bad.)

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: (But... I still have a ways to go.)

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: (If it wasn't for Rhodes Island, would 'non-Infected' like me ever truly understand the predicaments of the Infected? Would we even wish for everyone to be seen as equals?)

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: (It wasn't until I stopped being so cautious all the time that I finally noticed all the goodwill around me, small as they may be.)

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: (It was only then that I came to understand I still had the potential to take on an even greater cause and responsibility.)

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: (And now that I've understood that, there has to be even more areas where I can learn and improve.)

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: (I want to set my sights on something far more ambitious... Not like when I was still at Blacksteel, when all I wanted to do was to start a PMC that's 'just like Blacksteel.')

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: (For me, for my countrymen, and for all the Infected out there, I need to grow even more.)

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: (Right, I will definitely get there...)

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Captain Liskarm? Captain Liskarm!

steps.name: Click
steps.text: Think you can open up that bag for us?

steps.name: Myrtle
steps.text: The apples are about to come falling down—

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: What should I do with you girls...?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Hey, girls?

steps.name: Liskarm
steps.text: Apple picking isn't for another thirty minutes!
